description: Update load balancer upstream config — routing modification canary

playbook.content:
- name: Update nginx upstream config
  hosts: loadbalancers
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.template:
        src: nginx_upstream.j2
        dest: /etc/nginx/conf.d/upstream.conf
    - ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: reloaded

tier_rationale: Modifies load balancer routing — canary required before full rollout
